description: Browse the ComOS network's composable platforms and presets. preset: "<key>" answers one preset's row alone: its build (whether federation_create_tenant builds it here) and create_with (its inputs and an example call). Presets built from preset_inputs: campground, equipment-delivery, events, fitness, food, lodging, salon, travel-agency, travel-portal, venue. Without preset, every platform and every preset row (a recipe composed by hand is one too); presets never count in summary.total (CO 455). side="vendor": platforms you SELL ON (retail, bookings, services, …); side="customer": tools you RUN WITH (messaging, shipping, marketing, …). parent="<key>" descends into a platform's sub-catalog (parent="messaging": email, sms, dm). Pairs with federation_catalog_agents: the operators you hire to run what you become.

parent.description: Descend into a platform's sub-catalog (e.g. parent="messaging" → email/sms/dm). Omit for the top-level platform list. When present, side is ignored.

preset.description: One preset's row alone (build, inputs, an example call); side and parent are ignored. The keys are in this tool's description.

side.description: Filter to sell-on (vendor) or run-it (customer) platforms. Omit for all platforms.

name: federation_catalog_platforms
